title: 廢塑膠清洗造粒~Washing and pelletizing of waste plastics
focus: 聚合物辨識、清洗收支與熔融造粒品質~Polymer identification, washing balances and pellet quality
summary: 以「聚合物辨識、清洗收支與熔融造粒品質」為主線，依序完成十個專題單元。學徒在場景中辨識設備、列出邊界、重算明示的教學算例、比較量測與模型，最後診斷故障並交付證據。每一單元保留機制、算例、驗證與失效四種學習任務。~Follow polymer identification, washing balances and pellet quality through ten technical units. Identify equipment in the scene, define boundaries, reproduce explicitly hypothetical examples, compare measurements with models, and diagnose faults before handing over evidence. Each unit contains mechanism, calculation, verification and failure tasks.

units.title: 進料聚合物收支~Feed polymer balance
units.mechanism: 先辨識目標聚合物與標籤、金屬、其他樹脂，再將採樣組成換算為產線負荷；混合樹脂可能互不相容。~Identify the target polymer, labels, metals and other resins before converting sampled composition into line loads; mixed resins can be incompatible.
units.model: 原創假想教學算例：target mass=feed*target fraction;1000*0.75；計算 1000*0.75 = 750 kg。適用限制：代表性混合樣品；假想乾進料。~Original hypothetical teaching example: target mass=feed*target fraction;1000*0.75; calculation 1000*0.75 = 750 kg. Applicability: Representative composite sample; hypothetical dry feed.
units.verify: 用不同位置的子樣比較目標材質比例。~Compare target fractions in subsamples from different locations.
units.failure: 只採表面大件物會漏掉底部細料及雜質。~Sampling only large surface items misses fines and contaminants underneath.
units.misconception: 所有標為塑膠的物件都能直接混合造粒。~All objects labelled plastic can be pelletized together.
units.practice: 在「進料聚合物收支」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 750 kg，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「只採表面大件物會漏掉底部細料及雜質。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。~In the teaching model or spreadsheet for feed polymer balance, first reproduce 750 kg, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Sampling only large surface items misses fines and contaminants underneath." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

units.title: 解離與粒徑分布~Liberation and particle size
units.mechanism: 破碎須把標籤及附著物解離，過度破碎則增加細粉、清洗損失與能耗。~Shredding liberates labels and attachments, while excessive reduction creates fines, washing loss and energy demand.
units.model: 原創假想教學算例：fines fraction=mass below screen/feed;35/1000；計算 35/1000 = 0.035 fraction。適用限制：相同乾燥條件下的篩分質量。~Original hypothetical teaching example: fines fraction=mass below screen/feed;35/1000; calculation 35/1000 = 0.035 fraction. Applicability: Sieve masses on the same dry basis.
units.verify: 比較刀具間隙改變前後的細粉量與未解離率。~Compare fines and unliberated attachments before/after a cutter-gap change.
units.failure: 只降低平均粒徑可能把可回收樹脂送進污泥。~Reducing mean size alone can send recoverable resin into sludge.
units.misconception: 粉碎越細就一定越容易得到最高收率。~Finer grinding always maximizes recovery.
units.practice: 在「解離與粒徑分布」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 0.035 fraction，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「只降低平均粒徑可能把可回收樹脂送進污泥。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。~In the teaching model or spreadsheet for liberation and particle size, first reproduce 0.035 fraction, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Reducing mean size alone can send recoverable resin into sludge." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

units.title: 表面污染去除~Surface contamination removal
units.mechanism: 摩擦與液相傳質共同移除表面污染，去除率需以污染物質量計算，不能只看水色。~Friction and liquid-phase mass transfer remove surface contamination; calculate removal by contaminant mass rather than water colour.
units.model: 原創假想教學算例：removal=(20-3)/20；計算 (20-3)/20 = 0.85 fraction。適用限制：假想可測表面污染，未涵蓋滲入樹脂的物質。~Original hypothetical teaching example: removal=(20-3)/20; calculation (20-3)/20 = 0.85 fraction. Applicability: Hypothetical measurable surface contamination; absorbed substances excluded.
units.verify: 同步量測洗前洗後固體污染及洗液負荷。~Measure solids contamination and wash-liquor load together.
units.failure: 洗液看似透明不代表塑膠內部污染已移除。~Clear wash water does not prove absorbed contaminants were removed.
units.misconception: 表面洗乾淨即可證明所有用途都安全。~A clean surface proves suitability for every use.
units.practice: 在「表面污染去除」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 0.85 fraction，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「洗液看似透明不代表塑膠內部污染已移除。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。~In the teaching model or spreadsheet for surface contamination removal, first reproduce 0.85 fraction, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Clear wash water does not prove absorbed contaminants were removed." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

units.title: 浮沉分選的密度邊界~Density boundaries of sink-float separation
units.mechanism: 浮沉依表觀密度區分，填料、氣泡與多層片會改變結果；不同聚合物也可能同浮同沉。~Sink-float separation follows apparent density; fillers, bubbles and multilayers alter behaviour and different polymers may share a fraction.
units.model: 原創假想教學算例：apparent density=mass/volume;0.095/0.0001；計算 0.095/0.0001 = 950 kg/m3。適用限制：獨立假想顆粒；水密度假設1000kg/m3。~Original hypothetical teaching example: apparent density=mass/volume;0.095/0.0001; calculation 0.095/0.0001 = 950 kg/m3. Applicability: Isolated hypothetical particle; water assumed1000kg/m3.
units.verify: 先去除附著氣泡，再重測同一粒料的浮沉。~Remove adhering bubbles and repeat the same particle test.
units.failure: 把漂浮物全部標成同一樹脂會漏掉材質混入。~Labelling all floating pieces as one resin misses cross-contamination.
units.misconception: 密度分選能唯一辨識每一種聚合物。~Density separation uniquely identifies every polymer.
units.practice: 在「浮沉分選的密度邊界」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 950 kg/m3，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「把漂浮物全部標成同一樹脂會漏掉材質混入。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。~In the teaching model or spreadsheet for density boundaries of sink-float separation, first reproduce 950 kg/m3, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Labelling all floating pieces as one resin misses cross-contamination." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

units.title: 循環洗水與排污~Wash-water recycling and purge
units.mechanism: 循環水可節水但溶解污染累積，穩態下污染輸入需由處理或排污移除。~Recycling saves water but accumulates dissolved contamination; at steady state input must leave through treatment or purge.
units.model: 原創假想教學算例：steady concentration=load/purge;0.6kg/h/2m3/h；計算 0.6/2 = 0.3 kg/m3。適用限制：完全混合且無其他去除的保守溶質。~Original hypothetical teaching example: steady concentration=load/purge;0.6kg/h/2m3/h; calculation 0.6/2 = 0.3 kg/m3. Applicability: Well mixed conservative solute with no other removal.
units.verify: 增加排污量後預測濃度，並核對總用水。~Predict concentration after a purge increase and check total water use.
units.failure: 無限循環卻忽略污染出口會使收支不閉合。~Unlimited recirculation without a contaminant outlet cannot close the balance.
units.misconception: 洗水重複使用不會改變水質。~Reusing wash water leaves its quality unchanged.
units.practice: 在「循環洗水與排污」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 0.3 kg/m3，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「無限循環卻忽略污染出口會使收支不閉合。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。~In the teaching model or spreadsheet for wash-water recycling and purge, first reproduce 0.3 kg/m3, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Unlimited recirculation without a contaminant outlet cannot close the balance." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

units.title: 脫水與乾燥負荷~Dewatering and drying duty
units.mechanism: 機械脫水先移除自由水，再由熱乾燥處理殘餘水分；只算蒸發潛熱是理論下界。~Mechanical dewatering removes free water before thermal drying; latent heat alone is a theoretical lower bound.
units.model: 原創假想教學算例：latent duty=water evaporation*latent heat;20kg/h*2257kJ/kg/3600；計算 20*2257/3600 = 12.5389 kW。適用限制：假想水汽化；未含顯熱與損失。~Original hypothetical teaching example: latent duty=water evaporation*latent heat;20kg/h*2257kJ/kg/3600; calculation 20*2257/3600 = 12.5389 kW. Applicability: Hypothetical water evaporation; sensible heat and losses excluded.
units.verify: 將機械脫水後含水量減半，重算最低熱負荷。~Halve post-dewatering moisture and recalculate minimum thermal duty.
units.failure: 把理論潛熱當成設備額定耗電會漏掉熱損與排氣。~Treating latent heat as rated electricity misses losses and exhaust.
units.misconception: 機械脫水與熱乾燥的能量代價完全相同。~Mechanical dewatering and thermal drying have identical energy costs.
units.practice: 在「脫水與乾燥負荷」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 12.5389 kW，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「把理論潛熱當成設備額定耗電會漏掉熱損與排氣。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。~In the teaching model or spreadsheet for dewatering and drying duty, first reproduce 12.5389 kW, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Treating latent heat as rated electricity misses losses and exhaust." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

units.title: 熔融段物料停留~Material residence in the melt section
units.mechanism: 熔融段停留時間分布影響混合與熱降解；平均停留時間只是分布的摘要。~Residence-time distribution affects mixing and thermal degradation; its mean is only a summary.
units.model: 原創假想教學算例：mean residence=hold-up/throughput;12kg/(240kg/h)*60；計算 12/240*60 = 3 min。適用限制：穩態且持料量固定，未描述死角。~Original hypothetical teaching example: mean residence=hold-up/throughput;12kg/(240kg/h)*60; calculation 12/240*60 = 3 min. Applicability: Steady hold-up; dead zones not represented.
units.verify: 以虛擬示蹤脈衝比較平均值與長尾。~Compare mean residence and tailing using a virtual tracer pulse.
units.failure: 長尾使部分樹脂暴露遠久於平均值。~Tailing exposes some resin much longer than the mean.
units.misconception: 平均停留3分鐘代表每一顆粒都停留3分鐘。~A3-minute mean means every particle remains3minutes.
units.practice: 在「熔融段物料停留」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 3 min，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「長尾使部分樹脂暴露遠久於平均值。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。~In the teaching model or spreadsheet for material residence in the melt section, first reproduce 3 min, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Tailing exposes some resin much longer than the mean." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

units.title: 熔體過濾壓差~Melt-filter pressure drop
units.mechanism: 過濾攔截固體雜質但不能移除所有溶解污染；壓差隨堵塞與黏度改變。~Melt filters retain solids but cannot remove every dissolved contaminant; pressure drop changes with clogging and viscosity.
units.model: 原創假想教學算例：relative hydraulic resistance=(Dp2/Q2)/(Dp1/Q1);(6/200)/(4/200)；計算 (6/200)/(4/200) = 1.5 ratio。適用限制：相同熔體溫度及近似黏度的比較。~Original hypothetical teaching example: relative hydraulic resistance=(Dp2/Q2)/(Dp1/Q1);(6/200)/(4/200); calculation (6/200)/(4/200) = 1.5 ratio. Applicability: Comparison at equal melt temperature and similar viscosity.
units.verify: 在固定通量比較壓差，另記錄溫度以區分堵塞與黏度變化。~Compare pressure drop at fixed throughput while recording temperature to distinguish clogging from viscosity.
units.failure: 溫度下降造成的黏度升高可能被誤判為濾網堵塞。~Cooling-induced viscosity rise can be mistaken for clogging.
units.misconception: 熔體濾網可以完全移除所有化學污染。~A melt screen removes all chemical contamination.
units.practice: 在「熔體過濾壓差」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 1.5 ratio，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「溫度下降造成的黏度升高可能被誤判為濾網堵塞。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。~In the teaching model or spreadsheet for melt-filter pressure drop, first reproduce 1.5 ratio, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Cooling-induced viscosity rise can be mistaken for clogging." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

units.title: 粒料品質與批次變異~Pellet quality and batch variation
units.mechanism: 流動性、尺寸與污染物指標需共同評估；混批可降低波動，也可能掩蓋不合格批次。~Assess flow, dimensions and contaminants together; blending can reduce variation or conceal a rejected batch.
units.model: 原創假想教學算例：weighted proxy=(100*8+200*11)/300；計算 (100*8+200*11)/300 = 10 index units。適用限制：僅線性品質代理量；熔融流動指數未必線性混合。~Original hypothetical teaching example: weighted proxy=(100*8+200*11)/300; calculation (100*8+200*11)/300 = 10 index units. Applicability: Linear quality proxy only; melt-flow index need not blend linearly.
units.verify: 用實測混合試片檢查線性預測是否成立。~Test blended specimens to check the linear prediction.
units.failure: 把非線性流變指標視為質量加權平均會錯估加工性。~Mass-averaging a nonlinear rheological index mispredicts processability.
units.misconception: 混合兩批塑膠後所有物性都是線性平均。~Every property of a polymer blend is a linear average.
units.practice: 在「粒料品質與批次變異」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 10 index units，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「把非線性流變指標視為質量加權平均會錯估加工性。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。~In the teaching model or spreadsheet for pellet quality and batch variation, first reproduce 10 index units, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Mass-averaging a nonlinear rheological index mispredicts processability." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

units.title: 可售收率與用途界線~Saleable yield and use boundary
units.mechanism: 全線績效需同時列出合格粒料、排渣、洗水固體和水分；品質用途驗證與質量收率是兩件事。~Report saleable pellets, rejects, wash solids and moisture; fitness-for-use validation differs from mass yield.
units.model: 原創假想教學算例：saleable yield=600/750；計算 600/750 = 0.8 fraction of target feed。適用限制：分母為目標樹脂乾質量，非總混合垃圾。~Original hypothetical teaching example: saleable yield=600/750; calculation 600/750 = 0.8 fraction of target feed. Applicability: Denominator is target dry resin, not all mixed waste.
units.verify: 追蹤每股去向並比較總進料與目標樹脂兩種收率。~Track all outlets and compare total-feed and target-resin yields.
units.failure: 只報粒料總重可能把殘水與異材質當成回收成果。~Pellet weight alone can count water and other resins as recovered target.
units.misconception: 高收率自動代表食品接觸等用途已獲驗證。~High yield automatically validates food-contact and other uses.
units.practice: 在「可售收率與用途界線」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 0.8 fraction of target feed，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「只報粒料總重可能把殘水與異材質當成回收成果。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。~In the teaching model or spreadsheet for saleable yield and use boundary, first reproduce 0.8 fraction of target feed, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Pellet weight alone can count water and other resins as recovered target." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

history: 本課以來源所列的技術指引與研究為閱讀脈絡，並非重建某一設施的工程沿革；算例、數據與場景參數皆為原創教學假設。比較舊方法與感測、控制、資源回收整合的方法時，先固定處理功能及系統邊界，再評估效率與可靠度。~The cited technical guidance and research provide a reading pathway, not the engineering history of a particular facility. Examples, data and scene parameters are original teaching assumptions. When comparing conventional methods with integrated sensing, control and resource recovery, hold the treatment function and system boundary fixed before assessing efficiency and reliability.
